title: The Radio Boys' First Wireless; Or, Winning the Ferberton Prize
summary: "The Radio Boys' First Wireless; Or, Winning the Ferberton Prize" by Allen Chapman is a juvenile adventure novel published in 1922. The book launched the most popular of three competing Radio Boys series that emerged simultaneously in the 1920s.
